description: 外部验证 operator execution packet 契约。该执行包消费 closure work queue、proof-ref gate 和 category runbooks，输出覆盖所有外部验证 category 的脱敏操作步骤、证据模板、domain 分组和最终复核命令。该执行包不连接真实外部系统，不保存真实凭证或 endpoint，不把 operator packet ready 等同于 live passed。

executionPolicy.packetGate: blocked until real operator executes category runbooks, uploads redacted proof refs and downstream gates accept evidence.
executionPolicy.noNetwork: This generator must not execute production API, HF Space, Telegram Bot, Postgres, OTel, IdP, SIEM, Vault, developer portal or third-party audit commands.
executionPolicy.redaction: Output may contain owner/category ids, work item ids, command templates, required credential names, proof-ref patterns and hashes only; it must not contain endpoint URLs, credential values, DSNs, webhook secrets, chat ids, payloads, user inputs or production logs.
executionPolicy.sourceBinding: Output must bind to work queue sha256, proof-ref gate sha256, category runbooks sha256, proof-ref contract sha256 and current commit.

privacyBoundary: Operator execution packet 只保存 category、owner、workItemId、occurrence id、required credential 名称、脱敏命令模板、proof-ref pattern、artifact hash 指令、source hash、失败回滚和关闭条件；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、chat id、外部账号、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文或用户输入。
nonClaims: Does not execute external live checks.
Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not create accepted proof refs by itself.
Does not replace category-specific live gates.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
